data.name: Ikshita
data.long_meaning: Ikshita means 'desired, longed for, wished for' in Sanskrit. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'iksh' which means 'to see' or 'to desire'. The name symbolizes intelligence, vision, and prosperity.
